name: Cold-start AdamW Direct Persistence Screen
objective: Use a short sequence of effective-update differences to prioritize cases for exact 32-step confirmation; never issue a safety verdict from the short screen.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.moment_initialization: zero at the start, then evolved normally

short_screen.calibrated_null_score: available only for rows with preserved raw prefix update vectors; see prefix_null_reanalysis.json; missing rows remain ABSTAIN

confirmation.direct_persistence_label: full32 local effective-update coherence exceeds its own sign-flip 95% bound

families.RESULT_BLIND_DISCOVERY_12: mechanically selected 12 rows, including unresolved candidates

confirmation.unresolved_candidate_rule: A row that fails multiplicity correction remains unresolved and is excluded from confirmed-only performance metrics; it is never relabeled negative.

required_saved_statistics.raw_vectors: required for future per-step cross-Grams; if absent, output ABSTAIN and do not impute

heldout.selection: mechanical pool freeze before any heldout reveal
heldout.labels: all eligible rows receive 16-step screen and 32-step confirmation regardless of short result
heldout.all_negative_rule: report escalation, false escalation, abstention and cost; do not report recall or AUROC

claim_boundary: This protocol defines a fail-closed, cold-start AdamW direct-persistence screen. It is not a universal safety classifier and does not treat a short negative as proof of safety.
